spanish: Y los traerá al sacerdote, y acercará el que al pecado primero, y le pellizcará la cabeza desde frente a su nuca, y no separará.
grammarChanges: Replaced «torcerá» (twist) with «pellizcará» so the verb licenses the qal מלק sense of nipping/pinching off the head rather than twisting it (h03005008010, h03005008012).
readerNote: hold: clause role — whether the ל in «al pecado» is governed by the relative pronoun inside the verbless relative or by the main verb acercará is a preposition-governance choice, so that span is left unchanged.
